question: Legends League Cricket (LLC) appointed ________ as its ambassador for its All Women Match Official Team to promote women's empowerment initiatives and to increase the participation of women in cricket.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Jhulan Goswami".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhulan Goswam**i is an Indian cricketer.
 
• She is one of the fastest bowlers in the women's games.
 
• In 2007, she won the ICC Women's Player of the year award.
 
• She will be the face of the league which will increase the participation of women and promote** women's empowerment.**
 
• This is the first time in cricket that a women's match team would be officiating an entire men's league. 
 
• **Shandre Frtiz **from South Africa shall be the match **referee** for the entire league.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some current affairs related to cricket:
 
 
• The **Asia Cup 2022 **is shifted to** UAE** from Sri Lanka.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** won the** silver medal **in the 2022 World Athletics Championship.
 
• The Sports Authority of India has launched the campaign **"Create for India" **to cheer Indian contingents for participating in** Birmingham 2022** **Commonwealth Games.**
 
• **VVS Laxman** is the former Indian Cricketer who has been appointed to ICC Cricket Committee.
 
• **Para Sports Person of the year 2022** - Avani Lekhara
 
• **Lifetime achievement of the year award **- Sarkar Talwar
